neighbours.label: a piece inside a non-English place name that is still unfinished (V|ient|iane, Fu|ert|eventura, Mont| Blanc, Mont|pellier, Ville|font|aine); English names like Vermont or Montana stay quiet
fire: Backpackers usually cross the Mekong and spend a night in Vientiane before heading north.
The embassy in Vientiane issues visas within three working days.

Our ferry from Lanzarote reached Fuerteventura in under an hour.

The jazz festival draws thousands of visitors to Montreux every July.
The stage ended in Villefontaine after a long climb through the vineyards.
